id.about.title: Tentang Saya
id.about.p1: Lulusan S1 Informatika dari Universitas Islam Negeri Sunan Kalijaga Yogyakarta dengan IPK 3.72/4.00. Memiliki passion kuat dalam Software Quality Assurance (QA) serta latar belakang pengembangan web dan mobile.
id.about.p2: Pengalaman dalam pengembangan aplikasi memberikan pemahaman mendalam dari sisi teknis, sehingga memungkinkan perancangan dan eksekusi pengujian secara efektif dan presisi — baik melalui manual testing maupun automated testing.
id.about.p3: Terbiasa menguji sistem web & mobile (POS, CRM, healthcare system), merancang test case dari PRD & Figma, mengotomasi API & UI dengan Playwright, Cypress, Katalon Studio, serta berkolaborasi erat dengan tim developer.
id.about.summary: QA Engineer yang berdedikasi menjaga kualitas dan stabilitas perangkat lunak melalui pengujian manual dan otomasi yang terstruktur.
id.about.summary2: Berpengalaman berkolaborasi dalam siklus rilis Agile dan pelaporan bug yang mendalam.

en.hero.tagline: Ensuring every release is reliable, stable, and ready for users through comprehensive quality assurance.
en.about.title: About Me
en.about.p1: Informatics graduate from Universitas Islam Negeri Sunan Kalijaga Yogyakarta with a GPA of 3.72/4.00. I have a strong passion for Software Quality Assurance (QA) combined with a solid background in web and mobile development.
en.about.p2: My hands-on experience in software engineering helps me understand architectures from the technical side, enabling me to design and execute tests with high precision, both manually and automatically.
en.about.p3: Experienced in testing complex web and mobile platforms (POS, CRM, healthcare systems), building test cases from PRDs and Figma designs, automating APIs & UIs with Playwright, Cypress, Katalon Studio, and collaborating closely with engineering teams.
en.about.summary: Dedicated QA Engineer focused on structured manual and automated testing across web and mobile platforms, committed to software stability and high quality standards.
en.about.summary2: Experienced in Agile release cycles and comprehensive defect reporting.

en.edu.bangkit: Bangkit Academy led by Google, Tokopedia, Gojek, & Traveloka
en.edu.bangkitDesc: Certificate in Mobile Development. Mastered core concepts and technical capabilities required for professional Android development.
en.experience.title: Work Experience
en.exp0.l1: Conducted thorough testing of web-based and mobile Point of Sale (POS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) applications.
en.exp0.l2: Created detailed test cases for new features derived from Product Requirement Documents (PRD) and Figma designs.
en.exp0.l3: Executed manual testing workflows including User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Sanity, Regression, and Smoke testing for web and mobile.
en.exp0.l4: Safeguarded feature quality and system stability prior to production deployments.
en.exp0.l5: Actively collaborated with developers to investigate defect root causes and verify fixes.
en.exp0.l6: Reported and tracked defects clearly using Project Management Tools with comprehensive reproduction steps.
en.exp1.l1: Performed manual testing on web-based applications with targeted focus on the mobile viewport and user experience.
en.exp1.l2: Implemented automated API testing using Playwright to validate endpoint reliability, schema, and response codes.
en.exp1.l3: Managed defect tracking, severity classification, and status lifecycles using Jira.
en.exp2.l1: Conducted manual end-to-end testing for two flagship healthcare systems (Morbis and Morhuman) involving complex medical workflows.
en.exp2.l2: Identified, reported, and documented 20+ defects and feature discrepancies using internal reporting tools, enhancing system stability.
en.exp2.l3: Engineered automated test suites using Cypress on the Morclinic project to guarantee the integrity of key features.
en.exp3.l1: Ensured mobile software quality by developing and running mobile-based automated tests using Katalon Studio on the SUMU project.
